description_en: Queries statistics about outbound transfers of personal information
description_zh: 查询个人信息出境类型统计
kebab_example: aliyun waf-openapi describe-sensitive-outbound-statistic --instance-id waf-cn-0xldbqt0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2021-10-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeSensitiveOutboundStatistic

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the Web Application Firewall (WAF) instance.

Call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html operation to query the ID of the WAF instance
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例的ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html，查看当前WAF实例的ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The beginning of the time range to query. This value is a UNIX timestamp that is in UTC. Unit: seconds.

The compliance assessment feature supports querying data from the last month, the last 3 months, the last 6 months, the last 12 months, and from January 1 of the previous year to the present. Make sure that the time range is valid
parameters.help_zh:
查询的开始时间，格式为Unix时间戳（UTC时间），单位为秒。
合规审查当前仅支持查询最近1个月、最近3个月、最近6个月、最近12个月、自去年1月1日至今的数据，请确保时间的合法性
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en:
The end of the time range to query. This value is a UNIX timestamp that is in UTC. Unit: seconds.

The compliance assessment feature supports querying data from the last month, the last 3 months, the last 6 months, the last 12 months, and from January 1 of the previous year to the present. Make sure that the time range is valid
parameters.help_zh:
查询的结束时间，格式为Unix时间戳（UTC时间），单位为秒。

合规审查当前仅支持查询最近1个月、最近3个月、最近6个月、最近12个月、自去年1月1日至今的数据，请确保时间的合法性
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en:
The type of information to query. Valid values:

info: all personal information. This is the default value.

sensitive: only sensitive personal information
parameters.help_zh:
查询信息类型。取值： 
info：表示全部个人信息（默认）。
sensitive：表示仅个人敏感信息
parameters.name: sensitive_type

parameters.help_en:
The sensitivity level. Valid values:

high: high.

medium: medium.

low: low
parameters.help_zh:
敏感等级。取值： 
high：表示高敏感。
medium：表示中敏感。
low：表示低敏感
parameters.name: sensitive_level

parameters.help_en:
The type of sensitive data. Separate multiple types with commas (,).

Call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2859155.html operation to obtain the supported sensitive data types. This parameter supports only built-in sensitive data types
parameters.help_zh:
敏感数据类型，多个敏感数据类型之间使用英文逗号（,）分隔。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2859155.html获取支持敏感数据类型，当前参数仅支持内置敏感数据类型
parameters.name: sensitive_code

parameters.help_en:
The assessment result. Valid values:

report: a data outbound transfer threat exists.

none: no data outbound transfer threat exists
parameters.help_zh:
评估结果。取值：
report：表示存在数据出境风险。
none：表示不存在数据出境风险
parameters.name: detection_result

parameters.help_en: The number of the page to return. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时，返回第几页数据。默认值为1，表示返回第1页数据
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return on each page. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时，每页包含多少条结果。默认值为10，表示每页包含10条结果
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The field to use for sorting. Valid values:

total_count: sorts by the total number of personal information data entries. This is the default value.

outbound_count: sorts by the total number of outbound transfer data entries
parameters.help_zh:
排序字段的名称。取值：
total_count：表示数据总数（默认）。
outbound_count：表示出境数据总数
parameters.name: order_key

parameters.help_en:
The sorting order. Valid values:

desc: descending order. This is the default value.

asc: ascending order
parameters.help_zh:
排序的方式。取值：
desc：表示降序（默认）。
asc：表示升序
parameters.name: order_way

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the hybrid cloud cluster.

This parameter is available only for hybrid cloud scenarios. Call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2849376.html operation to query information about hybrid cloud clusters
parameters.help_zh:
混合云集群 ID。
只针对混合云场景，您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2849376.html获取混合云集群信息
parameters.name: cluster_id

parameters.help_en:
The region where the WAF instance resides. Valid values:

cn-hangzhou: the Chinese mainland.

ap-southeast-1: outside the Chinese mainland
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例所属地域。取值：

cn-hangzhou：表示中国内地。

ap-southeast-1：表示非中国内地
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud resource group
parameters.name: resource_manager_resource_group_id

Data.description_en: The list of statistics on outbound transfers of personal information
Data.description_zh: 个人信息出境类型统计列表

items.description_en: The statistics on outbound transfers for a specific sensitive data type
items.description_zh: 个人信息出境类型统计信息

DetectionResult.description_en:
The assessment result. Valid values:

report: a data outbound transfer threat exists.

none: no data outbound transfer threat exists
DetectionResult.description_zh:
评估结果。取值：
report：表示存在数据出境风险。
none：表示不存在数据出境风险

InfoCount.description_en: The total number of personal information data entries detected

OutboundCount.description_en: The number of outbound transfer data entries for the sensitive data type

SensitiveCode.description_en:
The code that represents the type of sensitive data.

Call the [DescribeApisecRules]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2859155.html） operation to obtain the supported sensitive data types
SensitiveCode.description_zh:
敏感数据类型。
您可以调用[DescribeApisecRules]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2859155.html）获取支持敏感数据类型

SensitiveLevel.description_en:
The sensitivity level. Valid values:

high: high.

medium: medium.

low: low
SensitiveLevel.description_zh:
敏感等级。取值： 
high：表示高敏感。
medium：表示中敏感。
low：表示低敏感

SensitiveType.description_en:
The type of information. Valid values:

info: all personal information.

sensitive: only sensitive personal information
SensitiveType.description_zh:
查询信息类型。取值： 
info：表示全部个人信息。
sensitive：表示仅个人敏感信息

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of entries returned for outbound transfer statistics
